title: School billing policy v1
description: A school's billing choices (catalog/policy.json). Every key is optional: a key left out keeps the default from the tiers spec ("Default billing rules"). Unknown keys are refused.

giftSessionMonths.description: Months a session gift certificate lasts. null: a gift add-on follows its grant's rollover months, or never lapses when it has none, and a gift code's credits never lapse.

rulesVersion.description: The grants' date rules. 1 (the default, and every policy stored without it): rollovers and one-time add-ons lapse on the UTC calendar. 2: on the menu's calendar (its timeZone).

revenueShare.description: B4 Uni's revenue share, negotiated per school: null (the default) for none, or a percentage of each payment collected, before Stripe's fee. 0 is no share.

percent.description: A percent from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals. The bounds are checked here; the two decimals are checked by resolvePolicy, not by a multipleOf, which a plain JSON Schema validator gets wrong in floating point for 1,363 valid rates such as 0.07.
